titleTr: Özgeçmişini anlat: Present Perfect ve Past Simple

explainTr: Past Simple (worked, moved), zamanı belli ve bitmiş olaylar için kullanılır: I worked in a bank in 2019. Yanında genelde in 2019, last year, ago, yesterday gibi bir zaman ifadesi olur.
Present Perfect (have/has + V3) zamanı belli olmayan ya da bugüne bağlanan olaylar için kullanılır: I have worked in three schools. Önemli olan sonuç ya da deneyimdir, zaman değil.

Pratik kural: Belli bir zaman ifadesi varsa Past Simple. Ever, never, already, yet, so far, this week varsa Present Perfect. Mülakatta 'Have you ever...?' diye başlarlar, detayı Past Simple ile anlatırsın.
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede 'çalıştım' hem bitmiş hem bugüne uzanan durumu anlatabilir. İngilizce ikisini ayırır: 'I worked there in 2019' bitmiş bir iştir, 'I have worked there' deneyimdir. 'Dün' gibi belli zamanla Present Perfect kullanılmaz.

exercises.q: She ___ three different jobs so far.
exercises.whyTr: 'So far' bugüne kadar demek: has + V3.
'When' ile belli zaman sorulur: did + yalın fiil.
Deneyim sorusu: Have you ever + V3?

reading.title: Hafsa writes her first American resume
reading.text:
Hafsa is writing her first American resume, and Linda is helping her at the kitchen table. "Start with your work experience," Linda says. "What have you done so far?"

Hafsa thinks for a moment. "In Isparta, I worked in a school office for six years. I answered the phone, organized files, and helped parents. I left that job in 2019, when we moved to the United States."

"That is good experience," says Linda. "What about here?"

"Since we arrived, I have volunteered at Emre's school. I have helped in the library, and I have read stories to small children. Last spring I also joined a field trip as a parent helper."

Linda smiles. "Then write all of that down. Employers like to see both what you did in the past and what you have done recently. Be careful with your verbs. Use the past tense for jobs that ended, like 'worked' or 'organized.' Use 'have' for things that continue until now, like 'have volunteered.'"

Hafsa types for an hour. At the end, she has a clear page with three sections: experience, skills, and references. Linda has agreed to be one of her references. "I have never written a resume in English before," Hafsa says, "but I think this one looks professional."

"It does," Linda says. "Now send it to Mr. Brown. The school hasn't hired a new substitute yet."

Why did Hafsa leave that job in 2019?
options: She did not like the office.
She found a better job in Isparta.
The family moved to the United States.
questions.whyTr: Metin: 'when we moved to the United States'.

questions.q: What has Hafsa done since she arrived?
options: She has volunteered at Emre's school.
She has worked at a bank.

questions.q: According to Linda, when should Hafsa use 'have'?

For things that continue until now
questions.whyTr: Linda: 'Use have for things that continue until now.'

listening.title: A job interview at the school office

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: Good morning, Hafsa. Thank you for coming. Please sit down.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Good morning, Mr. Brown. Thank you for seeing me.

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: I read your resume. You have a lot of office experience. Where did you work in Turkey?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: I worked in a school office in Isparta for six years.

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: Excellent. Have you ever worked in an American school?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Not as an employee. But I have volunteered in the library since last September.

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: That helps. Have you ever substituted for a teacher?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: No, I have never done that. But I have helped in a classroom many times.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: I started two years ago, when my son began fourth grade.

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: Good. We have two open positions. Are you available on Mondays and Wednesdays?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Yes, I am. I have also finished the online safety course you sent me.

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: Perfect. Please bring two references next week.

writing.promptTr: Mr. Brown'a başvuru e-postası yaz (80-120 kelime). Hem geçmiş (bitmiş) işlerini hem de bugüne kadar yaptıklarını anlat.
writing.promptEn: Write an email to Mr. Brown about a job at his school. Tell him about your past jobs and what you have done recently.
frames: Dear Mr. Brown, I am writing to apply for ...
Thank you for your time. Sincerely, ...
writing.model:
Dear Mr. Brown,

I am writing to apply for the substitute position at Lincoln Elementary School. In Isparta, I worked in a school office for six years. I answered the phone, helped parents, and organized student files. I left that job in 2019 because my family moved to the United States.

Since then, I have volunteered in the school library, and I have helped in my son's classroom many times. I have also finished an online safety course. I have never worked as a substitute teacher, but I learn quickly and I love working with children.

I am available on Mondays and Wednesdays. Thank you for your time.

Sincerely,
Hafsa
checklistTr: Bitmiş işler için Past Simple (worked, left) kullandın mı?
Bugüne kadar süren veya zamanı belli olmayan şeyler için have + V3 var mı?
'Yesterday, in 2019, ago' gibi ifadelerle Present Perfect kullanmadığından emin ol.
Selamlama ve kapanış (Dear..., Sincerely) var mı?
